mainEntity.name: Should I use an AI landing-page builder, ChatGPT, or a regular website platform?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The right tool depends on whether you need copy, design, funnel setup, research, or ongoing updates. A prompt library or specialized assistant may help with planning and drafts, while a visual page platform may still be needed for layout, hosting, forms, and publishing.

Context: People comparing AI builders often care about speed, customization, editing, integrations, and the ability to fix pages after generation. No single tool automatically solves every part of a launch.

Key factors:
- Editing control and platform compatibility
- Form, checkout, analytics, and email support
- Ability to reuse approved brand information
- Export, ownership, and ongoing maintenance

Practical guidance: List the required deliverables before choosing a tool. Test a small page with your actual offer instead of relying only on demonstrations.

Run My AI Business helps readers compare workflows and understand how specialized assistants fit together.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use an AI assistant for research, structure, and copy; use a page platform for design, hosting, forms, checkout, and analytics. Choose based on the full workflow, not the fastest demo. Check editing control, integrations, ownership, and maintenance before committing.
